name: Mobile Phones
description: Root category for all types of mobile phones and handheld communication devices.

name: Smartphones
description: Feature-rich mobile phones running advanced operating systems like Android or iOS.

name: Feature Phones
description: Basic mobile phones with limited functionality focused on calls and SMS.

name: Foldable Phones
description: Next-generation phones with flexible or foldable display technology.

name: Rugged Phones
description: Durable mobile phones designed to withstand extreme conditions and harsh environments.

name: Media Players & Other Devices
description: Non-phone handheld devices such as media players novelty phones and concept devices.

name: Ultra-Budget Smartphones
description: Sub-₹5000 Android smartphones targeting first-time users and rural markets.

name: Budget 4G Smartphones
description: Affordable 4G Android smartphones priced between ₹5000–₹12000 for everyday use.

name: Budget 5G Smartphones
description: Entry-level 5G-enabled smartphones offering next-gen connectivity at low prices under ₹15000.

name: Mid-Range Smartphones
description: Smartphones priced between ₹15000–₹35000 balancing performance and affordability.

name: Flagship Smartphones
description: Premium smartphones with top-tier processors specs and build quality priced above ₹35000.

name: Gaming Smartphones
description: High-performance smartphones optimized for gaming with advanced cooling high refresh displays and fast processors.

name: Camera-First Smartphones
description: Smartphones designed with a primary focus on photography and videography capabilities.

name: Luxury Smartphones
description: Ultra-premium handcrafted or limited-edition smartphones targeting high-net-worth individuals.

name: Concept & Novelty Smartphones
description: Experimental unverified or novelty smartphone concepts not yet mass-produced.

name: Basic Feature Phones
description: Voice and SMS only phones with no internet support targeting budget-conscious and rural users.

name: 4G Feature Phones
description: Feature phones with 4G VoLTE support enabling affordable internet access and HD voice calls.

name: Flip & Clamshell Feature Phones
description: Classic flip-style feature phones with a hinged clamshell form factor for compact portability.

name: Fold Phones
description: Foldable phones that open like a book to reveal a large tablet-sized inner display.

name: Flip Foldable Phones
description: Compact foldable phones that fold vertically in half like a traditional clamshell with a premium display.

name: Rollable & Flexible Phones
description: Experimental phones with rollable extendable or fully flexible bendable displays.

name: Outdoor & Military Rugged Phones
description: Phones built to MIL-STD or IP68/IP69K standards for outdoor adventure and military use.

name: Industrial Rugged Phones
description: Heavy-duty phones designed for factory warehouse and field service environments.

name: Media Players
description: Non-phone Wi-Fi handheld media devices such as the Apple iPod Touch.

name: Concept & Other Devices
description: Unverified novelty or concept devices that do not fit standard phone classifications.
